verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team-chat and agent platform, so developer-registered slash commands are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents registering custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box. The closest features are agents triggered by @mentions, persona-pack skills and lifecycle hooks, and the open Nostr protocol, which are adjacent mechanisms rather than a slash-command registration capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can register custom slash commands that users invoke from the message box
